Global private markets investment management firm Hamilton Lane has expanded its infrastructure and real assets investment team with the appointment of new senior team members based in North America and Europe.

Tara Speers joins as a managing director on the product team, with responsibility for capital formation for the infrastructure platform. Based in the firm’s Toronto office, Speers focuses on client and product management, including investor relations, fundraising and portfolio construction. She brings more than two decades of experience in the infrastructure sector, having served as a managing director at Fengate, where she focused on capital formation and investor relations, prior to Hamilton Lane.
